notes: The position-gradient generator cost is purely per texel: 206-225 ns/texel measured at 512, 1024 and 2048 square, and unchanged between a 2,048-triangle and a 250,632-triangle mesh. Meeting the 100 ms budget needs roughly 6 ns/texel, so the reference generator is about thirty-five times short and is single-threaded.

Stamp scaling holds: the identical 64-texel-radius stamp plans the same 16 touched tiles and deposits the same 12,892 texels on a 2048-square and a 16384-square canvas, whose canvas tile counts differ 64-fold (1,024 against 65,536).
